map.依据输精管造影中造影剂在输精管、精囊与射精管的显影情况，工具评估管道通畅性并提示: Based on contrast visualization in the vas deferens, seminal vesicles and ejaculatory ducts on vasography, the tool assesses patency and suggests the likely obstruction site (testicular end/inguinal/pelvic), aiding diagnosis of male obstructive azoospermia.
map.输精管/精囊/射精管通畅判定。: Determine patency of the vas deferens/seminal vesicles/ejaculatory ducts.
map.TURED 等手术指征。: Indications for procedures such as TURED.
map.：输精管、精囊、射精管均勾选通畅、部位 none → 精道通畅，不支持梗阻性无精: : vas deferens, seminal vesicles and ejaculatory duct all marked patent, site none → the seminal tract is patent, not supporting obstructive azoospermia.
map.部位=射精管、精囊明显扩张: Site = ejaculatory duct, seminal vesicles markedly dilated
map.：射精管梗阻 + 精囊扩张 → 建议 TURED（经尿道射精管切开）评估。: : ejaculatory duct obstruction + seminal vesicle dilation → suggest evaluating for TURED (transurethral resection of ejaculatory ducts).
map.腹股沟段、盆段、射精管；射精管梗阻常伴精囊扩张、精液量少。: The inguinal segment, pelvic segment and ejaculatory duct; ejaculatory duct obstruction often comes with seminal vesicle dilation and low semen volume.
map.定位明确后行显微/内镜重建或直取精+ICSI。: Once localized, proceed with microsurgical/endoscopic reconstruction or direct sperm retrieval + ICSI.
